title: Product form of the Rademacher measure
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, the uniform probability measure on the finite cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ equals the product, over its $n$ coordinates, of the uniform probability measure on $\\{-1,1\\}$.
